title: Appear
subtitle: 出現，究竟是哪一種「看起來／出現」？
description: 出現，究竟是哪一種「看起來／出現」？

falseSynonyms.zh: 變成不等於看起來 become 表示狀態真的改變；appear 有時只是表示看起來如此。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He became angry. He appeared angry.

falseSynonyms.zh: 到達不等於出現 arrive 強調到達某個地點；appear 只表示出現在視線或場合中。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She arrived at the station at six. She appeared at the door unexpectedly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 存在不等於出現 exist 表示某物存在；appear 表示它變得可見或被注意到。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The problem existed for years. It appeared in the report last month.

falseSynonyms.zh: 發生不等於出現 happen 表示事件發生；appear 表示某人、某物或情況出現。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The accident happened yesterday. A witness appeared later.

falseSynonyms.zh: 觀看不等於看起來 watch 是主動觀看；look 在這裡是「看起來」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I watched the game. He looked tired afterward.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可見不等於出現 visible 是形容詞，表示可以看見；appear 是動詞，表示出現或看起來。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The moon is visible tonight. The moon appeared from behind the clouds.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞與動詞不同 appearance 是名詞；appear 是動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His appearance changed. He appeared tired.

falseSynonyms.zh: 消失不等於出現 disappear 表示從視線中消失，意思相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The sun appeared from behind the clouds and disappeared again later.
